name: Fairmont Washington, D.C. Georgetown
positioning: Fairmont hotel at 2401 M Street NW in Georgetown, Washington, D.C., with renovated rooms and pets welcome
best_for: Guests who like to stay active with gym access, bikes and workout gear

facts.text: The hotel is at 2401 M St. NW in Washington, D.C.
Balance Gym includes an indoor salt water pool, a steam room, sauna and whirlpool.
Pets of all sizes are welcome as long as they are leashed at all times.
A limited number of bicycles are available for guests, subject to availability.
Turn down service is automatic for Signature Suite and Fairmont Gold guests and on request for all other rooms.
The hotel unveiled a renovation of its guest rooms and suites in June 2016.
Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2024 and 2026.
The hotel's dining showcases sustainable produce and authentic culinary talent.

highlights.text: Hotel guests receive complimentary membership to Balance Gym-Foggy Bottom, with access from the hotel's Mezzanine level.
Georgie, the Fairmont Canine Ambassador, greets guests at the hotel.
Rooms have eggplant-hued couches, tufted cream-colored headboards and custom-commissioned, politically savvy artwork.
Guests can rent a bike from the front desk and ride along the river to the Kennedy Center and Lincoln Memorial.
With Fairmont Fit, the hotel can have a premium brand exercise shirt, shorts and running shoes ready in the room on arrival.

considerations.text: Valet parking is paid, with unlimited in and out privileges.
Complimentary Wi-Fi is available to ALL - Accor Live Limitless members; non-members pay a daily internet fee.
WhataHotel notes an urban hotel setting without resort-style recreational facilities.
